steps.step: a fresh workspace with two Projects, an OWNER and a DEVELOPER
Configuração financeira opens NOT_CONFIGURED for a new Project
nothing on the page sends the developer to the public candidature
"Iniciar verificação" offers the two ways: a new Business, or an existing one
the form checks the @ is available as it is typed
the review repeats what will be sent
after sending, the page says IN_REVIEW with the @ requested
the documents are reported as they are — never "enviado" when storage is absent
the ONE Business application: origin DEVELOPER_PROJECT, for Project A, SUBMITTED
a reload still says IN_REVIEW, with the reference
the DEVELOPER sees IN_REVIEW with nothing to press or upload
a synthetic existing Business issued a consent code from its own session
connecting names the Business that consented
after a reload the Project shows the Business card — name · @handle · Verificado
the binding names the existing Business: nothing was created
